source: cartesi/rollups-contracts v3.0.0-alpha.10 deployment artifacts (deployments/<chain-id>/<Contract>.txt) and the cartesi/dave v3.0.0-alpha.6 release deployment-addresses asset
note: Rollups contract addresses are a deterministic CREATE2 deployment and were checked for the chains in verified_chains only. For any other chain, read deployments/<chain-id>/ in the rollups-contracts release before use. InputBox is also confirmed at the same address on Ethereum Mainnet. PRT (Dave) addresses differ per chain and are listed separately. test_contracts are the test tokens and test output builder from the same deployment artifacts; on the local devnet resolve them with `cartesi address-book`, where TestFungibleToken is listed as TestToken and TestNonFungibleToken as TestNFT (SafeErc20Transfer and QuorumFactory are not listed there). Session contracts (deployed apps, per-app output builders) are not included.
